mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales over the past two months indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as corporate earnings growth is anticipated.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production growth signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods where INDPRO growth decelerates by more than 0.3 percentage points year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as equity valuations face pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300.0 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST exceeds 1300.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index over the past two months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as the market prices in stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.
